purpose: Research ledger for unresolved projected-24 Racing & Sports rating gaps
policy: Only figures explicitly identified by Racing & Sports as an RAS/RR/Rating metric may be promoted into the public RAS peak map. Timeform figures, ambiguous race-card numbers, handicap weights and inferred values are excluded. Racing & Sports-authored material published by an official racing body is acceptable when the metric is explicitly labelled Racing & Sports Rating.

publicEvidence.evidence: Public form guide exposes career/form data but states 'Log in to view all runs and ratings'.
Public preview confirms staying profile but provides no explicit RAS rating.
Public form guide includes the runner but historical ratings are login-gated; no explicit public RAS peak identified.

2025 VRC final-field article written by Trent Crebbin - Racing And Sports explicitly publishes 'Racing & Sports Rating - 118' for River Of Stars. This is retained as a verified published R&S rating but is not promoted to the peak map because the article does not explicitly identify it as her career peak.

Standard public form page exposes career/run data and an unlabeled numeric display near the runner row, but also states 'Log in to view all runs and ratings'. The unlabeled number is not promoted to RAS.

Enhanced Form search result exposes a long sequence of structured numbers for Shockletz, but without a reliable public header mapping in the fetched response. Values are retained as unclassified source evidence only and are not relabeled RAS.
Confirms Archer Stakes win and ballot exemption; no explicit RAS rating published.
Public page confirms 2023 Melbourne Cup second over 3200m and states 'Log in to view all runs and ratings'. No explicit current RAS peak verified.

unresolved.note: Public R&S form/news searches have not produced an explicit RAS peak. Do not substitute Timeform or handicap-based values.

resolvedThisResearch.evidence: Racing & Sports-authored analysis states Vauban was the second-highest horse on the Racing & Sports ratings and explicitly says he held a peak rating of 122 when second to Kyprios in the Group 1 Irish St Leger. The 2024 VRC final-field article 'By Racing And Sports' independently labels Vauban 'Racing & Sports Rating: 122'.
